news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹239.2m market cap, or US$2.59m). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.033 (vs ₹0.024 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.033 (up from ₹0.024 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.66m (down 27% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹14.5m (up 38% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 29% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 32% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.022 (vs ₹0.01 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.022 (up from ₹0.01 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹55.6m (down 35% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.55m (up 113% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 17% (up from 5.2% in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 5% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 39% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
